description: Submit a request for a firm quote. Use it for one item (category, description, quantity) or for a whole list: pass items (the same line items you gave quote_list) or the list_id that quote_list returned. Covers office or IT items not matched by quote_office_supplies, custom event print and merch (backdrops, signage, branded merch, flyers, packaging), unusual specs, deadlines faster than any instant option, and orders for instantly priced items. Returns a reference; a firm price and date is sent to the contact email, usually the same business day. Nothing is charged until the buyer approves the firm quote. Singapore delivery only. Example input: {"items":["3 x HDMI cable 5m"],"needed_by":"2026-11-15","contact_email":"buyer@example.com"}.

category.description: For a single-item request, the kind of product or print job being quoted. Leave it out when sending items or list_id.

contact_email.description: Where to send the firm quote.

contact_name.description: Buyer's name, used to address the firm quote.

delivery_location.description: Delivery address or area in Singapore, or 'self-collect'.

description.description: Single-item requests: what is needed, with all known specs (brand, model, connectors, capacity, size, material, finish, colours, artwork status). For a list, any overall notes.

items.description: For a list request, the lines the buyer wants quoted, each a string like '2 x HDMI cable 5m' or an object with item, quantity and optional category, brand, model, specs (same shape as quote_list).

list_id.description: List requests: the list_id returned by quote_list (valid 14 days). Its lines are used when items is not given.

quantity.description: For a single-item request, how many units the buyer wants quoted.

name: request_quote
title: Request a firm quote
